hook.text: The poet was born on an island.

ferry.text: Satyavati, a fisherman's daughter, rowed a ferry.

sage.text: One day the sage Parashara, on pilgrimage, saw her, and desired her.

watching.text: Holy one, sages are watching from both banks.

mist.text: So he raised a mist that hid the river.

maiden.text: I am a maiden. How can I go home?

gift.text: You will remain a maiden. Now choose a gift.

scent.text: She chose a fragrance for her smell of fish, and gladly agreed.

born.text: That same day, on an island, she bore a son.
That same day, on a river island, she bore a son.

grew.text: He grew at once: Dvaipayana, the island-born. We call him Vyasa.

promise.text: Mother, think of me, and I will come.

cliff.text: Then the king asked: why were these godlike heroes born on earth?
